<!-- WHAT IS A DOCENT -->
<div class="content-section white-bg">
  <div class="section-inner">
    <p class="section-label">About the Program</p>
    <h2>What Is a JSM Docent?</h2>
    <p style="max-width:600px;">Think of it as being a friendly guide — no formal training required, just your experience and a welcoming spirit.</p>
    
    <div class="two-col">
      <div>
        <p>Remember your first JSM? The maze of sessions, the overwhelming schedule, the uncertainty about where to go or who to talk to? A docent is an experienced attendee who helps first-timers navigate all of that.</p>
        <p>You don't need to have all the answers. You just need to be approachable and willing to share what you've learned from attending past JSMs — the tips, the shortcuts, the unwritten rules that make the experience so much better.</p>
        <p>It's one of the simplest and most meaningful ways to give back to our community.</p>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="ribbon-card">
          <div class="ribbon-icon teal">🎗️</div>
          <div>
            <h4>Wear Your Ribbon</h4>
            <p>A special ribbon on your badge lets newcomers know you're someone they can approach with questions.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="ribbon-card">
          <div class="ribbon-icon gold">📌</div>
          <div>
            <h4>Sport Your Button</h4>
            <p>A distinctive docent button makes you easy to spot in sessions, hallways, and social events.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="ribbon-card">
          <div class="ribbon-icon coral">💬</div>
          <div>
            <h4>Start a Conversation</h4>
            <p>Answer questions, share tips, and help new attendees feel like they belong from day one.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- HOW IT WORKS PREVIEW -->
<div class="content-section cream-bg">
  <div class="section-inner">
    <p class="section-label">How It Works</p>
    <h2>Three Simple Steps</h2>
    <p style="max-width:600px;">Becoming a docent takes just a few minutes to sign up and minimal time at the conference.</p>
    
    <div class="card-grid cols-3">
      <div class="feature-card">
        <div class="step-number">01</div>
        <h3>Sign Up</h3>
        <p>Fill out a short form with your name, email, and a bit about you and your interests.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="feature-card">
        <div class="step-number">02</div>
        <h3>Pick Up Your Kit</h3>
        <p>At registration, grab your docent ribbon and button. Attach them to your badge so newcomers can easily identify you as a friendly resource.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="feature-card">
        <div class="step-number">03</div>
        <h3>Attend the Orientation</h3>
        <p>If you arrive in timne, join the Sunday First-Time Attendee Orientation session. Your presence means newcomers can meet you right away and have a familiar face for the rest of JSM.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- WHAT'S INVOLVED -->
<div class="content-section dark-bg">
  <div class="section-inner">
    <p class="section-label">The Commitment</p>
    <h2>What We're Asking Of You</h2>
    <p style="max-width:600px;">We designed this to be as light-touch as possible. Here's everything involved.</p>
    
    <div class="card-grid cols-2">
      <div class="dark-card">
        <div class="icon-wrap">🎗️</div>
        <h4>Wear Your Ribbon & Button</h4>
        <p>Attach them to your conference badge each day. They signal to newcomers that you're approachable and happy to help.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="dark-card">
        <div class="icon-wrap">😊</div>
        <h4>Be Friendly & Open</h4>
        <p>If someone approaches you with a question, give them a warm response. You don't need every answer — pointing them in the right direction is plenty.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="dark-card">
        <div class="icon-wrap">📋</div>
        <h4>Attend the Orientation</h4>
        <p>If you are available,join the Sunday First-Time Attendee Orientation session and help the newcomers get oriented to JSM.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="dark-card">
        <div class="icon-wrap">🎉</div>
        <h4>Enjoy JSM!</h4>
        <p>That's it. Go to your sessions, attend the events you want, and simply be available if someone needs help. No extra meetings or reports required.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    
    <div class="callout-note">
